jobs.description: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals . As Hims & Hers continues to expand how we use software, AI, and machine learning across our healthcare platform, we are looking for a Senior Manager, Global Regulatory Affairs (AI/ML) to lead regulatory strategy for these rapidly evolving areas. This role, you will own global regulatory strategy for software, AI/ML-enabled products, and cybersecurity requirements, helping teams understand what is possible, where regulatory risk exists, and how we can responsibly bring new capabilities to market. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Clinical, Quality, and Legal teams to shape product strategy early, navigate complex regulatory questions, and create practical paths forward. This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who combines deep regulatory expertise with strong judgment and business instincts. You are comfortable working in areas where regulation and technology are evolving quickly, can make complex topics simple, and know how to balance speed, innovation, and risk. jobs.description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. jobs.title: UK I Fractional Legal Counsel
jobs.description: About Infinite Lambda Infinite Lambda is a global data and AI consultancy on a mission to make innovation accessible. We help organisations build the data foundations and business context they need for enterprise AI to actually work: from modern data platforms to agentic enablement and our software solution, Flowline. We are a Certified B Corporation, with 7 legal entities around the world, and are proud to nurture a workplace where decent human beings can do their best work. Curiosity is our default setting, autonomy is non-negotiable, and impact is the whole point. The role As our Fractional Legal Counsel, you will be the senior legal partner to our COO, Exec team, and Board. In a fractional capacity, you will be part of the team, close to the people who win and deliver the work, and trusted to make the calls that keep us keep moving. We need someone who can start adding value from their first week. You will handle our most important contracts and legal questions across EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, and set up the templates, playbooks, and processes that let the business handle routine matters with confidence when you are not there. Being qualified in both England & Wales and the US means you can cover our two largest legal systems directly and coordinate local counsel everywhere else. You will report to the COO and work closely with our CFO and General Managers, as many of our legal questions (commercial terms, liability, entity structure and governance) sit at the intersection of legal, finance, and operations. As the business grows, you will also help us decide what our long-term legal function should look like. What you will own This role spans four pillars. jobs.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) im Bereich Legal
jobs.description: Mode ist unsere Leidenschaft - und das bereits seit über 55 Jahren. Saison für Saison entwickeln wir als familiengeführte Unternehmensgruppe erfolgreiche Kollektionen, die inzwischen in über 70 Ländern und 15.000 Schuhgeschäften zu finden sind. Unsere Maxime lautet: Immer ein bisschen mehr tun als der Wettbewerb, Dinge ausprobieren, ausgetretene Pfade vermeiden und die Bodenhaftung nicht verlieren. Dass dieses Konzept aufgeht, spiegelt unsere Erfolgsgeschichte wider. Werden Sie Teil dieses Erfolgs und bewerben Sie sich beim europäischen Marktführer der Branche. Für unsere Unternehmensgruppe suchen wir im Bereich Legal Sie als Werkstudent (m/w/d). Was Sie bei uns bewegen: Unterstützung des Corporate Legal & Compliance Teams bei der Auswahl, Implementierung und Weiterentwicklung rechtlicher Themen und Prozesse Unterstützung bei der Bearbeitung und Bewertung rechtlicher Fragestellungen im Tagesgeschäft Planung, Koordination und Nachverfolgung von Aufgaben und Projekten innerhalb des Legal-&-Compliance-Bereichs Eigenverantwortliche Koordination relevanter Teilbereiche und Arbeitspakete Aufnahme, Strukturierung und Bewertung von Anforderungen aus dem Business Recherche zu rechtlichen Fragestellungen und relevanten gesetzlichen sowie regulatorischen Entwicklungen Erstellung von Entscheidungsgrundlagen, Präsentationen und Handlungsempfehlungen Unterstützung bei der Erstellung, Prüfung und Weiterentwicklung von Dokumenten, Richtlinien und Prozesse Was uns ausmacht: Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit Gestaltungsspielraum, flachen Hierarchien und einer familiären Unternehmenskultur. Alles, was Sie zum Arbeiten benötigen: Klimatisierte Büros, kostenlose Parkplätze sowie eine moderne Arbeitsplatzumgebung. Ein Arbeitstag, wie für Sie gemacht: Dank unserer flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodelle und der Möglichkeit des mobilen Arbeitens können Sie Ihr Berufsleben optimal an ihr Privatleben anpassen. Mit uns profitieren Sie von Sonderkonditionen und Angeboten bei verschiedensten Vertragspartnern

jobs.title: General Counsel
jobs.description: We are hiring a General Counsel , reporting to the Chief Operating Officer (COO). This role leads Canonical ’s global Legal and Compliance function. This is a unique opportunity for an exceptional and commercially-minded senior lawyer to lead the legal and compliance function of a profitable, fast-growing technology company that is privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. We’re looking for someone with genuine fluency in the software industry and in open source dynamics, who can translate that insight into clear positions on licensing, commercial contracts and risk, and hands-on execution. Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, you will own Canonical's legal, regulatory and governance posture and lead a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. Your primary challenge will be to continue building both the team and the architecture: a management layer across two regions, and the governance, contracting and controls a public company needs, in an environment that regularly does things the industry has not done before. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams on licensing and IP questions, with the security function on customer assurance, and you will advise the Board and its committees directly. In our selection process, we prioritize intellect and judgement alongside depth of practice. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, an active licence to practice, and demonstrable exposure to a multilayered global operational environment. Location: This role will be based remotely in EMEA time zones. The role entails Leading the global Legal and Compliance function: setting it's structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas. Building and managing a management capability: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.
